glosses: digital; having to do with the fingers or toes
dealing with discrete values rather than a continuous spectrum of values
dealing with the display of numerical values

examples.text: A polícia encontrou alguma impressão digital?
examples.en: Did the police find any fingerprints?

examples.text: Que tipo de relógio você prefere? Digital ou analógico?
examples.en: Which kind of watch do you prefer, digital or analog?

examples.text: As suas digitais foram encontradas na faca.
examples.en: Your fingerprints were found on the knife.

examples.text: Não havia impressões digitais na faca.
examples.en: There were no fingerprints on the knife.
